# harmonysase Provider

Provider for the Check Point Harmony SASE (formerly Perimeter81) public API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    harmonysase = {
      source = "X-Guardian/harmonysase"
    }
  }
}

# Configure the Harmony SASE provider. The api_key may also be set via the
# HARMONYSASE_API_KEY environment variable; region via HARMONYSASE_REGION.
provider "harmonysase" {
  api_key = var.harmonysase_api_key
  region  = "eu" # one of: us (default), eu, au, in
}

variable "harmonysase_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Harmony SASE API key. Falls back to `HARMONYSASE_API_KEY`.
- `endpoint` (String) Override the API host (used for testing/mocks). When set, both auth and REST traffic are sent to this host.
- `rate_limit_burst` (Number) Token-bucket burst size for the rate limiter. Defaults to 10. Falls back to `HARMONYSASE_RATE_LIMIT_BURST`.
- `rate_limit_per_minute` (Number) Maximum API requests per minute. Defaults to 100, matching the documented Harmony SASE ceiling of 500 requests per 5-minute window per source IP. Lower this if running multiple processes from the same IP. Falls back to `HARMONYSASE_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE`.
- `region` (String) Harmony SASE deployment region. One of `us`, `eu`, `au`, `in`. Defaults to `us`. Falls back to `HARMONYSASE_REGION`.
